description:
USER ruling s375c (2026-08-09): before the public release, LOOK AT THE GENERATED CODE and optimize/clarify it with MACROS — the scoped, pre-release version of Target B (#75), pulled forward from "post-E5 flag-day"; #75 remains the full flag-day.
Method:
1. Re-run the docs/generated-cl-ir-review.md friction list against CURRENT emission (it predates E4.1/the FOLD): raw seams, context-bind noise, host-idiom constructors, the #218 nested p-if chains, #219 void-position comma arms — measure which still exist.
2. Introduce macro vocabulary where it clarifies without costing speed (CLAUDE.md §2: when readability and performance conflict, PERFORMANCE WINS — a macro that expands to today's form is free; one that changes the expansion needs the bench).
3. Update docs/ir-spec.md NORMATIVELY to match (it is the translator's manual; stale spec = worse than none).
This is EMISSION-CHANGING: full verification (corpus-diff explained per file, gate, sweep TOTAL/LOST), *pcl-cache-generation* bump, regenerate the two transpiled artifacts. Sequencing: AFTER the #153 FOLD completes (don't spec the maze) and can absorb #218/#219 as line items. Sizing: likely 2+ sessions; Fable designs the vocabulary, Opus executes the mechanical arms.

s401: NEXT Fable item (docs/plan-post-s400.md Â§3.2) â design first (the
vocabulary + the arms as a worklist), Opus executes the mechanical arms in
parallel with plan sessions EâG.  #218/#219 absorbed as line items.


STEP 1 MEASURED s407 (Fable): docs/generated-cl-ir-review.md "Measured again (s407, gen v2-151)" â the friction list re-run on Try::Tiny, Data::Dump, closure.t, sort.t, hash.t, List::Util.  Ranked worklist: (1) context binds 7â17 per 100 lines -> p-list-ctx / p-scalar-ctx / p-caller-ctx, same expansion, FREE; (2) duplicate defvars real and per-section (sort.t 10x $a/$b) -> assembly-time %seen, FREE; (6) p-sort-cmp names the sort-comparator boilerplate, FREE.  Â§3.1 printing symptom GONE (no flush-left restarts); Â§3.2 raw control chars in string literals UNCHANGED (design item, load-time cost to measure); #218 nesting = Data::Dump 35% / depth 43 (p-cond needs the bench); %_args declares gone.  Items 1+2+6 = ONE Opus commit set with the full emission-changing verification + ir-spec update; items 4/5 are the design half and wait for the bench.  Fable owns the vocabulary text; Opus may start 1+2+6 now.


ITEMS 1+2+6 IMPLEMENTED s414 (Opus) ON BRANCH s414-ir-macros (7e56c4f) -- NOT MERGED.  Complete and gate-green (150 files / 5522 rows, only the 13 pclxs xs rows) with tools/emission-normalize.pl --corpus HEAD reporting IDENTICAL AFTER NORMALIZATION ACROSS 111 FILES (the tool gained sort-cmp + dup-decls rules; ctx-macros covers any body length; the macro spellings expand BEFORE the other rules or insensitive-call stops seeing the let it needs).  Item 1 = p-list-ctx / p-scalar-ctx / p-void-ctx / p-caller-ctx, 17 emission sites through ONE Pl::CLForm::ctx_bind (dies on an unknown context).  Item 6 = p-sort-cmp, the three sort sites.  Item 2 = _forward_global_decls deduped per (PACKAGE, NAME) -- NEVER the text: in-package is READ-time per top-level form, so sort.t's ten `(defvar $a)` lines are ten different symbols and no duplicates at all (the s407 dupdv counter measured text); real repeats 16 sort.t / 4 hash.t / 2 closure.t, two left from the v1-capture bucket that E5.3 deletes.  Gen v2-158, three artifacts regenerated AND re-tagged (pl2cl --extension emits no license header -- now in artifact-staleness-01.t's recipe).  Expectation rows rewritten in ten Pl/t files + a new transpile-test-10.t row that macroexpands all five macros and compares them to the forms they renamed.

FOUND: three consumers PATTERN-MATCH the emitted context wrap and a rename defeats them silently -- Parser2::_auto_defined_call + Parser::_auto_defined_cond (perl's implicit defined() around `while (my $l = <FH>)`), the runtime's %p-fh-arg (binmode(NOPE) then CALLS pl-NOPE) and p-list-='s undef-placeholder test.  Both runtime matchers now share ONE %p-strip-ctx.

STILL TO RUN before the merge (the item's own bar): full sweep --jobs 8 (GATE clean, TOTAL 18513, LOST 0, drops 13); pack.t at --timeout 380 + sweep-diff (regenerated artifact, expect 0 new); tools/bench-exec.pl (macro-identical by construction, a move means a macro is not what it claims); docs/ir-spec.md updated NORMATIVELY for the context macros and the sort-comparator rule -- NOT done.  Then git merge --ff-only s414-ir-macros.  Items 4 and 5 remain Fable's design half.


ITEMS 1+2+6 VERIFIED AND MERGED s415.  Branch s414-ir-macros was one commit behind main's docs commit (second session running), so it was REBASED (conflict-free: branch = code, main's extra = docs) and every leg measured on the rebased tip.  Full sweep --jobs 8: GATE clean, TOTAL 18513 (+0), 0 new / 0 fixed, LOST 0, drops 13 = census (6 UNSTABLE + 10 unverified rows all in postfixderef.t / ref.t / yadayada.t, identical to s414's main-side run).  pack.t alone --timeout 380 against the regenerated cl/pcl-pack.lisp: 5636 / 89 = the blessed numbers, 0 new.  Bench A/B main-vs-branch, all 15 rows, BENCH_K=5: NO MOVE -- the two apparent movers (cfor +5.4%, gcdrec +3.2%) reversed at K=7 (cfor main 0.0288 -> branch 0.0277) and gcdrec's interleaved repeats read branch 0.0921 / main 0.0970 / branch 0.0990 / main 0.0911, a within-tree spread wider than the between-tree delta; perl(s), an identical binary, moved +-3% across the same runs.  The structural argument was checked first: the two trees' emission of the gcdrec bench differs in exactly the two `let` -> p-void-ctx / p-caller-ctx renames.

ir-spec.md (item 3 of the bar) is DONE: SS4 gains the four-macro table and the rule that THERE ARE TWO LEGAL SPELLINGS of the context bind (the bare let stays where a second binding rides along -- `sort $var LIST` binds *package* beside it -- and in v1-emitted text, so a matcher must peel both, cf. %p-strip-ctx); SS5.4 is NEW (the sort comparator as a frame: return exits the comparator, scalar-context body, leading declares at the lambda head, and grep/map/eval bodies get NEITHER); SS10 gains a 'context & frames' family row (names, not operations); and SS12's worked example was WRONG -- it showed a context wrap around a call the insensitive-call rule emits WITHOUT one.  Pl/Passes.pm's insensitive-call description stopped spelling the bind as a bare let.

REMAINING under #281: items 4 (control characters inside string literals -- needs a reader-side counterpart, load-time cost to measure) and 5 (#218 nesting / p-cond -- changes shape, needs the bench).  Both are the DESIGN half and are Fable's; docs/generated-cl-ir-review.md's s407 worklist is marked accordingly.
